text: {"lessons":["I should not sell just because a stock is below my average cost; I should reassess its prospects and my reasons for holding it instead of reacting to losses.","Repeated sales after sharp declines can lock in losses, so I should make deliberate decisions rather than trade out of fear or regret.","Because my savings support retirement, I should prioritize diversification and manageable position sizes to reduce the risk of large account swings."]}
